exposure: use of clippers instead of a razor
placental removal by umbilical cord traction
outcome: Surgical site infections (superficial incisional, deep incisional, and organ or space surgical site infections) occurring up to 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery at 23 weeks of gestation or greater between January 2015 and June 2018 at a single tertiary care center
finding: After implementation of a resident-driven quality initiative using a surgical bundle, there was a significant decrease in cesarean surgical site infections.
